name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Perch goes with at least one of Cody, Esther, or Cedarmere.
Esther, Pike, and Willowmere belong to different catches.
The angler at Cedarmere belongs to the Catfish Family.
Royce, Perch, and Willowmere belong to different catches.
Esther goes with either Trout or Foxglen (but not both).
The angler at Foxglen and the angler at Cedarmere are in the same family.
